summary: Redesigned Integrations Tab tested successfully. Backend: 18/18 tests passed. Frontend: All features working - COGS Summary, sub-tab filtering, cost per integration, verified/unverified highlighting, SOC 2 PDF export, and lock/unlock functionality.
critical_code_review_comments: COGS calculation correctly sums cost_monthly from all 17 integrations ($613.25 total, $600.00 verified)
Category filtering properly uses 'category' field from backend (infrastructure, payments, ai_communication, native_updates, security_auth, local_processing)
SOC 2 PDF generation uses fpdf2 and properly redacts sensitive credentials
Verified/unverified flags at both integration level (cost_verified) and detail level (detail.verified) for granular highlighting
Single column layout (vertical stacking) implemented correctly with space-y-3
Data-testid attributes present for all interactive elements enabling robust testing

success_rate.backend: 100% (18/18 tests passed - unlock COGS/costs/categories, SOC2 PDF)
success_rate.frontend: 100% - All UI elements verified (COGS summary, sub-tabs, cost badges, lock/unlock, SOC2 button)

Integration IDs: railway, vercel, mongodb, s3 (infra), stripe, apple_iap (payments), xai, resend, twilio (ai_comm), capgo, capacitor, google_places (native), webauthn, vapid, jwt (security), voice_biometrics, pdf_tools (local).

POST /api/admin/integrations/soc2-report - returns valid PDF (10.8KB, Content-Type: application/pdf, Content-Disposition: attachment)
